entries.text: ISB CONTROLLER
INTERCOM
ANNOUNCEMENT SYSTEM
UNKNOWN

ISB Controller: Mobile Task Force unit Epsilon-11, designated Nine-Tailed Fox, has entered the facility. All remaining survivors are advised to stay in the evacuation shelter or any other safe area until the unit has secured the facility.
ISB Controller: We'd like to advise all surviving personnel once again: Do not attempt to reach the exits. Either find a safe area or go into one of the many evacuation shelters inside the facility.
ISB Controller: An announcement to all personnel: The lift to Gate B has been locked down to ensure the safety of the upper areas of the facility.
ISB Controller: Please remember to stay inside the evacuation shelters until the facility has been secured.
ISB Controller: Control to Nine-Tailed Fox. We are now checking the camera feeds for potential threats.
ISB Controller: You should see any unauthorized intruders or escapees pinged on your navigation devices.
ISB Controller: Control to Nine-Tailed Fox, camera scan complete. Multiple stragglers. Their positions are now being broadcast to you.
ISB Announcement System: Attention. This Announcement sy-
Unknown: SYSTEMS NOW UNDER INSURGENCY COMMAND.
Unknown: ATTENTION. ALL PERSONNEL CURRENTLY NON-DECEASED
Unknown: REPORT TO TOP-SIDE FOR IMMEDIATE QUEESTIONING
ISB Controller: Attention all personnel. O5-1 has arrived on Helipad B. All security personnel are to report to the armory for security detail briefing.
ISB Controller: Attention all site personnel. Mobile Task Force Alpha-1, designated Red Right Hand, has landed on Helipad A, as well as members of the O5 Council.

ISB Controller: Personnel with Level 3 clearance and below are to evacuate the site immediately. An Alpha-1 operative will be assisting in the evacuation efforts. For any questions or inquiries, please contact your supervisor for more information.
ISB Controller: Mobile Task Force unit Nu-7, designated Hammer Down, has landed on Helipad A

ISB Controller: Due to the fact that this site is experiencing a mass containment failure and multiple power outages. Hammer Down was dispatched to this site instead of Mobile Task Force unit Nine-Tailed Fox.
ISB Controller: We estimate the situation will be under control within two hours. We will start announcing additional status reports in regards to containment and the restoration of power.
Announcement System: The facility has been switched to emergency power. Please remain where you are and await evacuation.
Announcement System: A power system failure has been detected. All personnel must remain at their current locations until further instructions.
Announcement System: Emergency power has been activated. All personnel must suspend work immediately and await the arrival of the evacuation team.
Announcement System: A critical facility failure has been detected, and you will all die! Are we actually using this one?
